An engulfed creature who is no longer [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) moves to the nearest unoccupied space [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to the brick. The brick is hidden until they act.
